visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands on a narrow outdoor street with buildings and parked scooters in the background. She wears a white baseball cap, a white sleeveless crop top, and white pants. She smiles broadly, looking directly at the camera while clapping her hands and gesturing with her fingers. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a hair salon. The woman points toward a row of light blue hair-washing chairs. The room is brightly lit with white walls and posters. She then turns and points toward a sleek, white, modern-looking machine with a transparent dome and a digital screen. (3) The woman is shown interacting with a self-service kiosk. She inserts banknotes into a slot and touches options on the digital interface, which displays various service prices. A paper receipt is printed from the machine, and she holds it up close to the lens. (4) The woman lies down on a reclined chair with her head inside the white machine's dome. A staff member is seen briefly adjusting her position. Water sprays and foam are visible through the transparent lid, accompanied by red lighting inside the capsule. The woman looks relaxed and makes several hand gestures to communicate. (5) In the final phase, the woman is sitting up in the salon. A towel is wrapped around her head, and a staff member assists with drying. She later appears with her hair dry and loose, running her hands through it and smiling with a satisfied expression while looking at the camera.
